steps.name: ephemeral envelope key module
criteria: generate_ephemeral_envelope_keypair() returns UntweakedKeypair without panicking
Two consecutive calls return keypairs with distinct secret keys
Function takes no arguments (no mnemonic, no seed, no network)
steps.implementation_notes: Create new file with OsRng. In-memory only, never persisted, never seed-derived.
